description: Pre-Delete: tombstone the AD-integrated DNS A record CloudBolt registered for each server being decommissioned, over LDAP via the ldap_dns shared module. Uses only the identity stored on the server at create time and tombstones only when the live A value still matches (ownership-verified). Idempotent and PROVFAILED-safe: nothing recorded, already gone, or a record now pointing elsewhere all return WARNING, not FAILURE.
name: AD DNS - Delete A Record
